# Tool reference

<!-- GENERATED BY scripts/generate-tools-doc.py - DO NOT EDIT BY HAND -->

Every tool the Delta Browser MCP server advertises, grouped by what it is for.
The same list is served live by `tools/list` and is asserted in the test suite,
so this page cannot drift from the binary without CI noticing.

Run `delta tools` for the machine-readable form, or `delta tools | jq` to pipe
it somewhere else.

**62 tools in total.**

## Navigation

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `navigate` | Navigate to an HTTP(S) URL |
| `reload` | Reload page |
| `go_back` | Go back in history |
| `go_forward` | Go forward in history |
| `wait_for` | Wait for visible, hidden or attached selector |

## Reading the page

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `snapshot` | Get accessibility tree with session-scoped element refs. With delta:true returns only elements changed since the previous snapshot on this tab |
| `get_text` | Read element text |
| `get_attribute` | Read an attribute |
| `get_dom` | Get raw page HTML |
| `get_url` | Get page URL |
| `get_title` | Get page title |
| `get_computed_style` | Read computed styles |

## Interacting

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `click` | Click a referenced element or CSS selector |
| `double_click` | Double-click element |
| `right_click` | Right-click element |
| `fill` | Set input value and dispatch input/change |
| `type` | Append text to a focused input |
| `check` | Check checkbox |
| `uncheck` | Uncheck checkbox |
| `select_option` | Select option by value |
| `hover` | Move mouse to element center |
| `drag` | Native CDP pointer drag; assert application drop outcome separately |
| `press_key` | Press Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, or one character |
| `scroll` | Scroll page |
| `evaluate` | Execute JavaScript in current page; trusted clients only |
| `upload_file` | Upload from explicitly configured DELTA_UPLOAD_ROOT |

## Tabs

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_tabs` | List only this session's tabs |
| `new_tab` | Create a tab in this browser context |
| `switch_tab` | Switch active tab |
| `close_tab` | Close owned tab |

## Session state

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `save_state` | Export cookies, tabs, storage and scroll; not a process checkpoint |
| `restore_state` | Stage state in a new context with pre-boot storage; retain old context on failure |

## Cookies

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `get_cookies` | Get this context's cookies |
| `set_cookie` | Set cookie in this context |
| `clear_cookies` | Clear this context cookies |

## Capture

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `screenshot` | Capture PNG or JPEG as base64 |
| `annotate_screenshot` | Screenshot with temporary ref overlays |
| `save_pdf` | Print page to PDF as base64 |

## Observability

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `get_console_logs` | Read current-tab console and exception events |
| `get_network_log` | Read bounded current-tab CDP network events |
| `save_har` | Save observed CDP HAR; missing measurements -1, bodies omitted |
| `get_performance` | Read measured page timings; unavailable values are null |
| `get_memory_usage` | Read real V8 heap and DOM counters |
| `intercept_request` | Current-tab interception; mock requires operator DELTA_ALLOW_NETWORK_MOCKS=1 |

## Testing

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `test_run` | Execute line-based test steps; no shell execution |
| `test_assert_text` | Assert element text |
| `test_assert_attr` | Assert element attribute |
| `test_assert_url` | Assert URL |
| `test_assert_visible` | Assert element visibility |
| `test_report` | Save last test result as escaped HTML or JSON |

## Efficiency

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `batch` | Run several tools in order in one MCP message. Sequential, shares one browser, stops at stop_on_error |

## Server control

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `server_status` | Get session status and honest capability information |
| `server_shutdown` | Stop only this session worker, never other clients |
| `server_profile_list` | List implemented and unavailable sandbox profiles |
| `server_profile_set` | Tighten managed worker profile before browser starts; no relaxation |
| `server_logs` | Read bounded metadata-only session operation log |
| `cdp_raw` | Restricted current-target CDP allowlist, not unrestricted CDP |

## Other

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `close` | Dispose this session browser context and managed worker |
| `get_bounding_box` | Get element client rectangle |
| `set_geolocation` | Override coordinates without granting permissions |
| `set_user_agent` | Set current-tab user agent |
| `set_viewport` | Set viewport dimensions |

## Why some tools exist

`batch` and `snapshot { delta: true }` are not convenience wrappers.
Each MCP message is a latency boundary, so batching several actions
into one message and returning only the elements that changed are the
two largest levers on agent runtime and context window. See
[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

## Safety

Page content is untrusted input. `evaluate` runs JavaScript in the
page's origin and can reach anything the page can reach. Check
`server_status` before assuming a sandbox boundary is in place.
